# pheno-go-ctxkit

`context.Context` helpers with built-in trace IDs and structured cancellation.

## Install

```bash
go get github.com/kooshapari/ctxkit@latest
```

## Public API

```go
import "github.com/kooshapari/ctxkit"

// 1. Background with trace ID
ctx := ctxkit.Background("trace-abc-123")

// 2. With timeout
ctx, cancel := ctxkit.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()

// 3. Extract trace ID
tid := ctxkit.TraceID(ctx)
// tid == "trace-abc-123"
```

## Functions

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `Background(traceID string) context.Context` | Root context with trace ID |
| `WithTimeout(ctx, d) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc)` | Wraps `context.WithTimeout` + trace propagation |
| `WithDeadline(ctx, t) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc)` | Wraps `context.WithDeadline` + trace propagation |
| `WithCancel(ctx) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc)` | Wraps `context.WithCancel` + trace propagation |
| `TraceID(ctx context.Context) string` | Extracts the trace ID; returns `""` if missing |
| `IsCanceled(ctx context.Context) bool` | `ctx.Err() != nil` shortcut |

## Environment

None. Pure library, no global state.

## Common errors

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded` | Timeout fired | Increase duration or remove `WithTimeout` |
| `ctx.Err() == context.Canceled` | `cancel()` was called | Don't call `cancel()` until done |
| `TraceID(ctx) == ""` | Context wasn't created via `ctxkit.Background` | Use `ctxkit.Background("...")` as the root |

## Scope-out

- NOT a logger. Use `pheno-go-logkit` (when it exists) or `slog`.
- NOT a tracer. Use `pheno-go-otel` (when it exists) or `otelhttp`.
- NOT a worker pool. Use `pheno-go-pool` (when it exists) or `errgroup`.

## Tests

`go test ./...` — 6/6 (3 unit + 2 race + 1 example)
